en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's get some fresh air
Let's go for a run
Let's relax in the sun

The purity of nature is a common 
theme across many cultures.

Sometimes, the taste of the air can be
an indicator of location or weather.

Ooh...just speaking of it has made 
me want to travel to far-off lands.

Perhaps you would like to accompany 
me on my travels once we escape.

I'm not fond of vigorous exercise, but...
perhaps it will be enjoyable.

It is through many different experiences
that one is able to understand humanity.

Kehehe... Being with you has gained
me a number of new experiences.
I will decline...

I have some manner of condition where
I overheat after being in the sun too long.

<CLT=cltMIND>...Probably because you're wearing
all black clothes...

<CLT=cltMIND>Korekiyo is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Korekiyo's inner thoughts...?
